shots.title: Situation
shots.prompt: Photorealistic commercial. Two distinct adults A and B; A faces B, asks a warm question; B listens without speaking. Client brief: Publicité narrative avec deux personnages adultes, un cadeau, 20 secondes. Preserve identities and product from the supplied real reference photo. No generated text or logos. Casting: A is adult A; B is a distinct adult with a separate voice. Speaker A speaks in French with a contemporary metropolitan French accent, warm conversational timbre, approximately 150 words per minute: "Tu as pensé à moi ?". Vary pitch across phrases; lift the question ending when applicable, then settle on the response. Use a short natural pause at punctuation, emphasize one meaningful word, allow a small audible breath. Synchronize mouth movement with speech; a slight eyebrow response, one motivated hand gesture, small smile after the phrase. Other visible characters listen without speaking. Keep the same voice across shots for this speaker; preserve the reference identity. No background narration and no competing voices. Creative adaptation: Establish one shared obstacle or situation before the resolution. Use a difference in viewpoints to motivate an emotional reaction.
